item.title: The Hidden Costs of Technological Progress: Risks, Governance, and Sustainability in the Transition from Industry 4.0 to Industry 5.0
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the often-overlooked negative externalities and challenges accompanying technological progress, particularly in the shift toward Industry 5.0. Rather than celebrating innovation uncritically, the call invites research that interrogates the hidden risks, governance gaps, and sustainability concerns that emerge during major industrial transitions.

The special issue seeks contributions that address how societies can navigate technological change while minimizing harm, establishing effective governance mechanisms, and ensuring sustainable outcomes. It welcomes interdisciplinary perspectives on the complex relationship between technological advancement, environmental protection, social welfare, and economic viability.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Risks associated with technological advancement and digital transformation
  • Governance frameworks for emerging technologies
  • Sustainability implications of Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0
  • Environmental and social costs of technological progress
  • Policy and regulatory approaches to managing technological transitions
  • Ethical considerations in technology deployment
  • Human and organizational impacts of industrial transformation
